description: This Python module defines a SkipTagsAggregator class that extends SimpleTextAggregator to prevent sentence boundary detection within specified tag pairs during text aggregation. It processes text asynchronously, respecting custom tag delimiters to keep tagged content together, particularly useful for processing content with inline tags or delimiters that should not be subjected to sentence segmentation.

classes.name: SkipTagsAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator class that buffers text and prevents sentence end detection within specified start/end tag pairs, extending SimpleTextAggregator and managing internal tag states during asynchronous text processing.

methods.name: __init__(self, tags: Sequence[StartEndTags])
methods.description: Initializes the SkipTagsAggregator with a sequence of start/end tag definitions and sets the internal tag state variables.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[Aggregation] aggregate(self, text: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text character-by-character, updates tag states, and yields aggregations when sentence boundaries are detected outside tags.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Handles interruptions by resetting the internal tag state and discarding partially aggregated text.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the aggregator's internal buffer and tag tracking state to initial conditions.
